study type: prospective, randomized, double-blinded dose finding study
cohort: 75 parturients undergoing cesarean delivery with combined spinal-epidural anesthesia
finding: An earlier administration of 4 mg prophylactic ondansetron contributed no benefits for lowing the dose of prophylactic phenylephrine compared to a late administration, but can decrease the dose of preventing phenylephrine in patients undergoing cesarean delivery with combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
